item.title: [+1] US 'Very Close' To Finalising Trade Deal With India, Says Rubio Days After Trump Waives Russia Oil Tariffs
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 29 reports from Business Today, The Economic Times, Deccan Chronicle and 22 more. Related: “America very close to finalising trade deal with India: Marco Rubio”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 18 Oct).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−2] Southern India braces for water stress and droughts amid deficient monsoon
item.description:
Signal: weak monsoon or sowing. 3 reports from CMB News, Global Agriculture, Business Standard. Related: “India Trims Foodgrain Target as Weak Monsoon and El Nino Squeeze Kharif Harvest”. Mixed: 2 reports point the other way. New in the last 24 hours.

Agri & fertilisers: headwind (−2) — Crop output at risk

Why it matters: Poor rains hurt harvests and rural incomes, weighing on rural demand and raising food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Food inflation to rise through 2027 as war, El Nino hit global supplies
item.description:
Signal: higher global food prices (global). 2 reports from Telegraph India, BusinessLine. Related: “UP in bottom two in Sept sugar inflation table, Tamil Nadu tops”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 13 Oct).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Export prices firm

Why it matters: Dearer world food, edible oil and fertiliser raise India's import costs and food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
